response.justification: The candidate comfortably exceeds every technical requirement — deep TypeScript/Node.js and React experience, REST/web architecture expertise, Kubernetes and AWS exposure, and even LLM/MCP agent tooling work matching the nice-to-haves. However, with nearly 20 years of experience and multiple Senior/Staff titles, he is significantly overqualified for an entry-level position, raising real concerns about salary alignment, engagement, and retention in a junior IC role.
strengths: Strong TypeScript, Node.js, and React fullstack experience across multiple production platforms
Hands-on LLM/MCP integration, Kubernetes, and AWS experience covering the nice-to-have list
Berlin-based with a track record of ownership, mentoring, and clean-architecture practices (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: Heavily overqualified for an entry-level role — likely salary and retention mismatch
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (MongoDB/MySQL background instead)
Only basic German, which may hinder work in a German energy-consulting domain

key_factors.factor: LLM, AWS, and Kubernetes nice-to-haves covered
